newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys 250,000/bbl April reformate at $28.60.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 250,000/bbl April reformate at $28.60.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought by tender just one 250,000-barrel cargo of unleaded 95-octane reformate in April at $28.60 per barrel, cost and-freight (c-and-f), a company official said on Wednesday.
The tender which closed March 18 and was valid for two days, sought an April 16-30 cargo to Keelung, Taichung, Kaohsiung or Shalung.
Taiwan last bought April 1-15 requirements - 250,000-barrels of each of leaded and unleaded reformate - at close to $29.00 per barrel, c-and-f, from a western trader.
